# Access request

Request systems through the Access catalog. Pick the role template instead of custom permissions when possible.
Emergency production access needs dual approval and an expiry time.

# Access revoke

When an employee leaves, HR opens an offboarding ticket. IT revokes SSO, VPN, and badges the same day.
Managers must remove shared mailbox ownership before the last day.

# Billing invoices

Download invoices from the Billing portal under Documents. Filter by month and cost center.
Missing invoices: check the vendor email and spam folder, then open a billing ticket.

# Billing refunds

Refunds for unused seats require finance approval. Attach the original invoice and seat report.
Refunds appear in 10–15 business days on the corporate card statement.

# Database access

Read-only prod access uses a bastion and short-lived credentials.
Write access is limited to migration jobs. Ad-hoc UPDATEs in production are forbidden.

# Database backups

Production databases take nightly snapshots. Point-in-time recovery is available for 7 days.
Restore requests need a change ticket and DBA approval. Never restore over production without a freeze window.

# Feature flags

New risky features ship behind flags. Default off in production until a gradual rollout.
Kill switches must be documented in the runbook before launch.

# Deploy pipeline

Merges to main trigger staging. Production deploy needs a green pipeline and an approved change ticket.
Rollback uses the previous container image tag. Hotfixes still go through CI.

# Outlook and email

Configure Outlook with SSO. Shared mailboxes appear automatically after access approval.
If calendar sync fails, remove the account profile and add it again.

# Phishing report

Forward suspicious email as an attachment to security@company.example.
Do not click links. Security responds within one business day with a ticket id.

# P1 incident response

P1 means customer-facing outage. Page the on-call engineer and open a bridge call within 5 minutes.
Post status updates every 15 minutes until mitigation. Write a postmortem within 48 hours.

# Status page updates

Only incident commanders publish status page changes. Use templates: investigating, identified, monitoring, resolved.
Never blame a vendor by name on the public page.

# Laptop docking station

Connect the USB-C dock before opening the lid. Displays should appear within 30 seconds.
If external monitors stay black, update the dock firmware from the hardware portal.

# New laptop setup

New hires receive a laptop with disk encryption and the company MDM profile.
Install the VPN client, SSO browser extension, and chat app from the software portal.
First login must be on the office network or through onboarding Wi-Fi.

# Onboarding accounts

IT creates email, SSO, and wiki accounts before the start date.
Contractors get time-boxed accounts. Extensions require manager approval in the ticket.

# Onboarding checklist

Day one: badge, laptop, SSO account, Slack or Teams, HR portal.
Request tool access through the Access catalog. Managers approve within one business day.
Complete security training in the first week.

# Password reset

Use the Forgot password link on the SSO screen. A reset email is sent to your work inbox.
Temporary passwords expire in 24 hours. Do not share reset links in chat.

# Printer setup

Install the floor printer from the software portal using the building and floor codes.
Badge printing requires a second authentication tap on the printer panel.

# Lost laptop

Report a lost or stolen laptop immediately to IT security. The device will be remotely locked and wiped via MDM.
File a police report number in the ticket when available.

# USB policy

Personal USB drives are blocked by MDM. Approved encrypted drives can be requested through the Access catalog.
Exceptions expire in 30 days.

# Chat workspace

Join the company workspace with your work email. Default channels: #general, #it-help, #announcements.
Private channels require an invite from a current member.

# SSO login

Corporate apps use single sign-on. Open the app, choose Company SSO, and sign in with your work email.
If login loops, clear browser cookies for the identity provider and retry.
After a password change, wait up to 15 minutes or re-authenticate MFA.

# SSO MFA

Multi-factor authentication is required for SSO. Approve the push on your phone or enter the authenticator code.
If the device was replaced, ask IT to reset MFA enrollment before the next login.

# VPN reset

If the corporate VPN will not connect, open the VPN client, sign out, and choose Reset connection.
Clear the local VPN cache, reconnect to the office network profile, and verify MFA succeeds.
Common errors: timed out, authentication failed, tunnel established but no internet.

# VPN split tunneling

Split tunnel sends only corporate traffic through the VPN. Enable it in Advanced settings when video calls become slow on VPN.
Disable split tunnel when you need full network isolation for security testing.

# Guest Wi-Fi

Reception issues a guest code valid for 8 hours. Codes are single-use and logged.
Do not share guest codes for employee devices; use CorpWiFi instead.

# Office Wi-Fi

Connect to CorpWiFi and sign in with SSO. GuestWiFi is for visitors and has no intranet access.
Captive portal issues: forget the network, reconnect, and accept the certificate.
